user.title: Balcony Battery Manager (Solarbank 4)
user.description: Before you start: set the Solarbank to third-party control in your Anker Solix integration. Select 5 sensors and 2 actuators below; all values can be changed later. Numbers are example defaults.

measurements.name: Measurements
measurements.description: Sensors the controller reads. Power sensors may report W, kW or MW; state of charge must be in %.

data_description.p_batt_draw: Power of your main house battery. Used to reconstruct the real house demand.
data_description.batt_draw_positive: Turn off if this sensor is NEGATIVE while the main battery discharges (e.g. E3DC).
data_description.grid_export_positive: Turn off if this sensor is NEGATIVE while exporting.
data_description.p_anker_out: AC power the Solarbank currently feeds into the house.
data_description.p_anker_pv: PV power at the Solarbank inputs.
data_description.sun_entity: Provides the next sunset. If empty, sunset is calculated from the Home Assistant location (last resort: 21:00).

actuators.name: Solarbank actuators
actuators.description: Third-party-control entities of your Anker Solix integration that the controller writes to.

data_description.grid_flow_select: Select of the Solarbank that switches between charging and discharging (third-party control).
data_description.grid_flow_discharge_option: Exact option value of the grid-flow select that means discharge/feed-in.
data_description.grid_flow_charge_option: Exact option value of the grid-flow select that means charging.
data_description.target_power_number: Number of the Solarbank that takes the power setpoint (W or kW). Values are clamped to its min/max.
data_description.mode_select: Optional select of the Solarbank's operating mode. Needed to hand control back to the Anker app when the controller is disabled.
data_description.control_mode: Option of the operating-mode select that enables third-party control. Selected before power is commanded.
data_description.restore_mode: Option of the operating-mode select that is restored when the controller is disabled (e.g. the Anker app's own mode).

discharge.name: Discharge staircase
discharge.description: Two-step feed-in support when the house draws a lot from the main battery.

data_description.discharge_threshold_1: Corrected demand above this feeds stage 1. Must be lower than threshold 2.
data_description.discharge_threshold_2: Corrected demand above this feeds stage 2.
data_description.discharge_stage_2: Feed-in power of stage 2. The Solarbank 4 accepts at most about 800 W here.
data_description.dwell_minutes: A condition must hold continuously this long before the stage changes.
data_description.hysteresis: Demand must drop this far below a threshold before stepping down.
data_description.min_discharge_soc: No discharge (staircase or grid support) at or below this Solarbank SoC.

charging.name: Predictive PV charging
charging.description: Charge from PV surplus only if PV alone will not reach the target by sunset.

data_description.max_charge: Upper limit for charging. Example default; also capped at the target number's maximum.
data_description.surplus_reserve: Export kept while charging, so charging never pulls from the grid or main battery.
data_description.capacity_kwh: Usable Solarbank capacity incl. expansion batteries. Example default - set your own value.
data_description.pv_nominal_w: Peak PV power at the Solarbank, used for the remaining-PV estimate.
data_description.afternoon_hour: From this local hour the PV estimate is capped.
data_description.afternoon_factor: After the boundary the PV estimate is capped at nominal power x this factor.

grid_support.name: Grid support (main battery empty)
grid_support.description: Cover the house from the Solarbank when the main battery is empty.

data_description.grid_support_enabled: Cover the house from the Solarbank while the main battery is empty.
data_description.main_soc: Required for grid support. Leave empty to disable it.
data_description.main_empty_soc: Grid support starts at or below this main-battery SoC.
data_description.main_empty_soc_hyst: Grid support ends once the main-battery SoC is this far above the empty level.
data_description.grid_support_margin: Grid import that is deliberately left uncovered.
data_description.grid_support_max: Upper limit during grid support; also capped at the target number's maximum.

general.name: General
general.description: Control loop timing and write deadband.

data_description.deadband: Minimum setpoint change before the target number is rewritten.

error.threshold_order: Threshold 1 must be lower than threshold 2.
error.stage_order: Stage 1 feed-in must not be higher than stage 2.
error.grid_flow_option_missing: The grid-flow select does not offer the configured 'discharge' or 'charge' option.
error.mode_select_missing: Select the operating-mode entity to use a control/restore mode.
error.mode_option_required: Enter a mode while controlling and/or a mode when disabled.
error.mode_option_missing: The operating-mode select does not offer the configured option.
error.power_unit_invalid: A power sensor uses an unsupported unit (supported: W, kW, MW).
error.number_unit_invalid: The target power number must use W or kW.
error.actuator_in_use: These actuators are already controlled by another Balcony Battery Manager entry.

abort.already_configured: This Solarbank is already controlled by Balcony Battery Manager.
